LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Feature_: If disabled, the player may change research to anything, allowing them to circumvent the main feature when desired.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Reroll_A: If disabled, projects that are not selected will stay in the list until researched.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Manual_R: Whether the Reroll button in the research tab can replace the projects you are being offered.
The player cannot manually force a reroll of the available options.
The player can force a reroll of the available projects once. A new reroll is gained every time a project is completed.
The player can force a reroll of the available projects at any time.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Availabl: The number of research projects offered to choose from.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Force_Lo: If enabled, all projects come from the lowest tech level available, so it must be completed before projects from the next level are offered.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Restrict: If enabled, only projects at or below the player faction's tech level are offered.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Allow_On: If enabled, one offered project may be above the tech level limit.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Allow_Sw: If enabled, the other choices stay available after one is selected. The choices still reroll after a project is finished (if rerolling is enabled).
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Prevent_: Suppress projects for this many rerolls
Prevents projects from reappearing as choices for this many rerolls. If nothing else could be offered, they may be offered again sooner. Completing a project also counts as a reroll.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Progress: Offer choices if they are partially researched
How partially researched projects are handled. A book is one way to get a partially researched project.
Partially completed projects get no special treatment. They only appear if the randomizer selects them.
Partially researched projects are never offered.
A partially researched project replaces another choice when new choices are offered. Gaining progress does not remove a choice already on offer.
Partially researched projects are offered as additional choices.

An additional choice is offered only when the project gains progress.\n\nIf switching between choices is disabled, the choice is not added while a project of the same kind is being researched. Read a book while you could select a project if you want its project added to the choices.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Type_Of_: Number of projects to choose from
Whether the number of offered projects is fixed or grows with the size of your colony.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Static_P: The number of projects to choose from is constant.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Dynamic_: The number of projects to choose from depends on the number of colonists who can research.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Addition: One more choice is offered for every X colonists who can research.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Max_Proj: Never offers more random projects than this. Depending on "Offer choices if they are partially researched", the total can go above it. This only limits the choices added by colonist count.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Equalize: Picks half of the offered choices so that the average research cost of the choices is close to the average of all possible projects.\n\nPrevents being offered only expensive projects while cheap ones are available.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Verbose_: Logs how the offered choices are picked. Fills the log quickly, so keep it off unless you are debugging something.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_AutoOpen: Automatically open the Semi Random Research window and pause the game when a project finishes.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_ShowGrap: Shows the research rate graph on the active research card.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_ShowComp: Show completion dates instead of time left
Show research estimates (offers, the timings panel and tech level progress) as the in-game dates they should finish on, instead of the time remaining.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_TimingsC: Time the current tech level instead of all research
In the timings panel, show the time to finish the remaining standard research of your current tech level instead of all remaining research.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_ShowLett: Sends a letter when a research project is finished.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_ColorGro: Color and group by tech level

When enabled, standard research offers are colored and grouped under Neolithic/Medieval/Industrial era headers, and the top progress bar is split by era. When disabled, standard offers use a flat list with neutral colors and the top bar is a single uncolored total of all research. Anomaly and Gravship sections are unchanged.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Adaptive: When enabled, the research window grows taller to show every offered or snoozed project instead of using a scroll bar. It never shrinks below its normal size, and a scroll bar still appears if the list is taller than the screen.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_TreeButt: Which research tree the switch button at the bottom of Semi Random Research opens. That button is named after the tree it will take you to. Only trees you have installed are listed. The Research tab itself reopens whichever window you last switched to, so this button is how you change it. Defaults to Node Research when it is installed, then YART, then Sleek Research Tab, then Nice Research Tab, then Research: Organized.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Suppress: Hide the messages shown when switching between Semi Random Research and another research tree (Node Research, YART, Sleek Research Tab, Nice Research Tab or Research: Organized).
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_Restrict: Locked on while Node Research is installed. Node Research controls tech-level progression.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Setting_OneHighe: Disabled while Node Research is installed. Node Research controls tech-level progression.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_TreeButtonTip: Open the research tree. Prohibit normal project selection still applies if it is enabled.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_TreeButtonTip_No: Open Node Research. Prohibit normal project selection still applies if it is enabled.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_PauseResearchTip: Stop colonists from researching this project. It stays selected as current research until you resume. Other kinds of research carry on.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_ResearchPausedAl: Research is paused. Colonists will not work on the paused project until you resume it. Click to open the research tab.
{0} is paused. Colonists will not work on it until you resume it. Other kinds of research carry on.\n\nClick to open the research tab.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_HistoryEmpty: No research has been completed yet.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_HistoryTip: Click to show recently completed research. Pick a project to see what it unlocked.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_HistoryBackTip: Return to the current and available projects.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_AutoToggleTip: Auto research: when nothing is being researched, the cheapest project on offer is started for you. The pick only happens once you close this window, so you always get the chance to choose yourself first.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_AutoToggleStateO: Currently on. Click to turn off.
Currently off. Click to turn on.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_FinalResearchPre: Completing this project satisfies the remaining research prerequisite. Click to inspect.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_TimingRateTip: Standard research points per day, measured every hour and averaged over up to the last ten days. Every time estimate uses this speed.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_TimingIdleTip: No standard research is in progress.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_TimingPausedTip: {0} is paused. Resume it to count down again.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_TimingTreeTip: Time to finish all {0} remaining standard projects, including those not yet available: {1} research points. Snoozed projects and those they set aside are left out, and tech levels or other requirements may hold some back for longer.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_TimingEraTip: Time to finish all {0} remaining {1} standard projects, including those not yet available: {2} research points. Snoozed projects and those they set aside are left out, and other requirements may hold some back for longer.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_TimingNoRateTip: Estimates appear once research progress has been measured. It is measured every hour and averaged over up to the last ten days.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_NodeResearchTech: Node Research: this era is the limit of what your tech level can research. Advance by finishing its Emergence project.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_GenesisTechLimit: Genesis: this era is the limit of what your tech level can research until your colony advances to the next era.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_ProgressionCoreT: Progression: Core: {0}% of {1}% required to advance
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_ProgressionCoreR: Ready to advance to the next tech level!
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Handover_Node_Re: Switched to Node Research. Prohibit normal project selection is still on.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Handover_Node_Fr: Switched to Node Research. Free selection enabled.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Handover_Semi_Re: Switched to Semi Random Research. Selection restricted.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Handover_Yart_Re: Switched to YART. Prohibit normal project selection is still on.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Handover_Sleek_R: Switched to Sleek Research Tab. Prohibit normal project selection is still on.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Handover_Nice_Re: Switched to Nice Research Tab. Prohibit normal project selection is still on.
LanguageData.CM_Semi_Random_Research_Handover_Organiz: Switched to Research: Organized. Prohibit normal project selection is still on.
